svg.title: Record the absorption spectrum
svg.desc: Measure absorption of the as-grown samples using a Perkin Elmer Lambda 2 UV-Vis. The source does not specify the absorption specimen support or loading; the quartz PL support is not silently inherited. Conceptual geometry; no measured apparatus design.
